Get TPBL Player Game Log

Source: R/tpbl.R
tpbl_player_games.Rd

A player's game log in one division: one row per game played, with that game's whole stat line.

Endpoint: GET https://api.tpbl.basketball/api/players/{player_id}/games/stats

Usage

tpbl_player_games(player_id, division_id)

Arguments

player_id

Required. TPBL player id (one per person across seasons and teams); player_id in tpbl_roster. Not the GoHoops person id and not the roster id.

division_id

Required. TPBL division id (one competition phase of one season: 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 = 2024-25 preseason, regular season, playoffs, postseason challenge, finals; 8, 9, 11, 12, 35 = 2025-26; 655, 656 = 2026-27); division_id in tpbl_divisions. Not the GoHoops division id. Without it the API answers HTTP 422; an unknown id answers HTTP 500, which is not retried.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: A player's game log in one division: one row per game played, with that game's whole stat line. An empty answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py tpbl_player_games):

col_nametypedescription
player_idintegerTPBL player id (key space: TPBL players; one per person across seasons and teams): the {player_id} of the player routes. Not the GoHoops person id and not the roster id.
gohoops_person_idintegerGoHoops person id (key space: GoHoops persons; one per human). Not the TPBL player id and not the roster id.
gohoops_roster_idintegerGoHoops roster id (key space: GoHoops rosters = one player registered with one squad in one season; it changes when the player changes season or team). His roster in the division: join tpbl_box_players to tpbl_roster on it. Not the TPBL player id and not the person id.
playercharacterPlayer name (Traditional Chinese, or a transliteration for foreign players).
division_idintegerTPBL division id (key space: TPBL divisions, one competition phase of one season; 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 = 2024-25, 8, 9, 11, 12, 35 = 2025-26, 655, 656 = 2026-27): the {division_id} of every division route. The division asked for. Not the GoHoops division id.
gohoops_division_idintegerGoHoops division id (key space: GoHoops divisions; e.g. 64 = the 2024-25 preseason, 65 = the 2024-25 regular season). Not the TPBL division id.
team_idintegerTPBL team id (key space: TPBL teams = franchises, 2-8 so far; stable across seasons): the {team_id} of the division team routes. Not the GoHoops franchise id and not the squad id. The team the player played for in that game.
teamcharacterName of the team the player played for in that game. Team name in Traditional Chinese with the sponsor (Kaohsiung Aquas, Formosa Dreamers, Hsinchu Lioneers, Taoyuan Leopards, New Taipei CTBC DEA, New Taipei Kings, Taipei Mars).
game_idintegerTPBL game id (key space: TPBL games on api.tpbl.basketball): the {game_id} of the game routes. Not sequential by date (2024-25 = 1-1367, 2025-26 = 1371-8641, 2026-27 = 27535-27667). The box score echoes no game id, so a box frame parsed without the request stamp has a null game_id.
gohoops_game_idintegerGoHoops game id (key space: GoHoops games; 1242 for TPBL game 6). Not the TPBL game id.
game_titlecharacterGame title: the division name and the game number counted from the end (<division name> Game 124 = regular season, game 124).
home_team_idintegerTPBL team id of the home team of the game (franchise, 2-8).
away_team_idintegerTPBL team id of the away team of the game (franchise, 2-8).
home_scoreintegerHome team final score in the game.
away_scoreintegerAway team final score in the game.
venuecharacterVenue name in Traditional Chinese (the API's game location).
tipoffPOSIXctScheduled tip-off as a naive timestamp (no zone). Taiwan local date and time (UTC+8 by every tip-off seen; the API sends no zone).
periods_playedintegerNumber of quarters in which the player was on court in this game.
scoreintegerPoints scored by the player in the game of this row (accumulated_stats of a one-game row is that game's total).
reboundsintegerTotal rebounds by the player in the game of this row (accumulated_stats of a one-game row is that game's total) (offensive + defensive).
assistsintegerAssists by the player in the game of this row (accumulated_stats of a one-game row is that game's total).

turnoversintegerTurnovers committed by the player in the game of this row (accumulated_stats of a one-game row is that game's total); equals the sum of the *_turnovers type columns (checked on 4,237 played player lines of 189 games).
foulsintegerFouls charged by the player in the game of this row (accumulated_stats of a one-game row is that game's total): personal + technical + unsportsmanlike + disqualifying; equals defensive_fouls + offensive_fouls (checked on 4,237 played player lines of 189 games).

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these are the routes the tpbl.basketball site's own front end calls on api.tpbl.basketball (read from its JavaScript bundle). The API is keyless and needs no headers; tpbl.basketball/robots.txt answers 200 with an empty body. The runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Coverage: three seasons so far (2024-25 = season 2025 to 2026-27 = season 2027). There is NO play-by-play route; the two shot lists carry court coordinates only, with no shooter, game, quarter or time. Names (teams with their sponsor, venues, players, referees) are Traditional Chinese; the column descriptions translate the codes.

  • Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26). The API keys a season by its own small integer (1, 2, 3 = 2024-25, 2025-26, 2026-27); the runtime reads tpbl_seasons once per session and sends that id. A year the list lacks is hoopR_no_data.

  • Ids: every route takes TPBL's own ids (season, division, team, game, player); the gohoops_* ids belong to GoHoops, the stats platform behind the league, and are echoed beside them. The box score keys its players by gohoops_roster_id (a person registered with one squad in one season), not by the TPBL player id: join tpbl_box_players to tpbl_roster on gohoops_roster_id. Every id is an integer. tipoff is a POSIXct in Asia/Taipei (the API sends naive Taiwan-local times).

  • Finished games only: the game wrappers first read the game detail (cached per session) and refuse (hoopR_asset_fetch) a game that is not COMPLETED or still live; the box-score wrappers also refuse a stats body whose teams (in home / away order), final scores, quarter count or player points disagree with it. The season game list, the roster and the player game log are checked against the object asked for; the two shot lists name no team, player or division in the body, so only their shape and court bounds are checked. tpbl_games(verify = TRUE) also checks every division's completed games against its standings (falling back to the team-filtered lists for a division whose standings answer empty, as the 2024-25 playoffs do).

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, a season the API does not list, an empty list such as the standings of a playoff division), hoopR_bad_request (a non-integer id or season, HTTP 400 / 422, an invalid verify or rounds, raised before the request where it can be) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other failure: a non-2xx after retries, a non-JSON body, an error envelope, an unfinished game, a body that disagrees with the object asked for). HTTP 500 is retried on every route except the player game log, where an unknown division_id answers 500 deterministically: it fails after one request. Wrappers raise; they never warn and return an empty frame.

See also

Other TPBL Functions: tpbl_box_player_periods(), tpbl_box_players(), tpbl_box_team_periods(), tpbl_box_teams(), tpbl_divisions(), tpbl_game(), tpbl_games(), tpbl_player_shots(), tpbl_referees(), tpbl_roster(), tpbl_seasons(), tpbl_standings(), tpbl_standings_against(), tpbl_team_shots(), tpbl_teams()
